captions.detailed: A 3D model of a cylindrical handle designed for a hex wrench. The handle features a dome-shaped top, a tapered lower section, and six deep longitudinal grooved channels spaced evenly around its circumference to provide an ergonomic grip. A deep vertical slot runs along one side of the handle to accommodate the hex wrench shaft, accompanied by small rectangular horizontal pass-through slots near the bottom designed to secure the tool with zip ties.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for a customizable hex wrench handle. It must feature a cylindrical body with a rounded dome top, a tapered bottom, external grip grooves, a central shaft hole, a side slot for the wrench, and integrated slots for zip-tie attachment.
captions.factory: The handle is constructed by unioning a bottom conical cylinder, a main central cylinder, and a top sphere to form the outer body. A difference operation then subtracts several elements: a series of rotated cylinders distributed in a for-loop to create the external grip grooves, a central cylinder for the hex shaft hole, a small bottom cone for entry clearance, and several translated cubes to form the main wrench slot, bend clearance, and multiple zip-tie routing channels.
